issues.body:
### Minecraft Version

1.20.1

### Mod Version

21.0.4

### Mod Loader

Forge

### What environment are you running the mod in?

Client

### Issue Description

When KubeJS registers a custom attribute, modifying its script file after initialization (changing base, min or max value) no longer works because apparently AttributeFix just replaces the values from its own config. I did not know this mod also mess with modded attributes and nearly lost my mind trying to solve this issue. I hope this gets fixed and nobody else experiences this ever again.

now a days most of us share the same concept or mod arrangement and their categories when it comes in building a fresh version with a pre-defined modlist...
 as usual we start the game with either sodium or optifne and then their fellow mods especially performance related mods.....
it is crystal clear that (attribute fix) deals with modded attribute system and here comes the real puzzle:

should we install the mods adding mobs and creatures and then regulating their attributes by installing (attribute fix) after all of them or installing (attribute fix) and then applying all the mods related to adding creatures and mobs.

to put things in summary what i want to reach for here is:
the effect of (attribute fix) will be more magical if install it before all the mods that add additionl creatures to game and then the mod applies the correct attribute environment to their stats or (attribute fix) should be installed and put above all of them to its affect to be better on gameplay?
